admissions.reason: Acute Kidney Injury is a distinct clinical entity from Sepsis and Rhabdomyolysis, though it can be a complication of both.
Sepsis is a distinct clinical entity from Acute Kidney Injury and Rhabdomyolysis, though it can cause both.
Rhabdomyolysis is a distinct clinical entity from Sepsis and Acute Kidney Injury, though it can cause the latter.
